text: For integrity-sensitive inputs, add a regression that mutates the semantic payload and require validation to reject the mismatch; reject missing, empty, or blank authoritative collections before sealing.

Every quantitative script must assert at least one computed value against a quantity known INDEPENDENTLY of the pipeline, and abort on mismatch. On 2026-08-29 four results were reported before being found wrong: a 15bps cost assumption 5-100x too high; a screen 'beating the benchmark' by holding TQQQ/SQQQ/TLT; market caps from split-adjusted prices times as-reported share counts (AAPL at $309B vs $1.27T); and a compliance screen passing names with no debt data. Each was caught by comparing one number to outside knowledge. Use scripts/lib/research-assertions.ts anchor(). An anchor derived from the same pipeline it checks proves nothing.

Any selection rule must print what it actually selected before its performance is believed. On 2026-08-29 a full-universe screen reported beating SPUS by 12.18pp/yr; its holdings were SPY, QQQ, TQQQ (3x leveraged), SQQQ (3x inverse) and TLT — borrowed beta dressed as alpha, two impermissible outright, because the universe never excluded funds. No summary statistic would have revealed this; one line of holdings did. Also run every ranking rule against a random null control drawn from the identical eligible set: momentum returned 8.29%/yr against random's 13.20%, which comparison to the benchmark alone would not have surfaced.

Never resolve missing inputs toward the permissive side of a screen or filter. A boolean verdict forces 'no evidence' into one of two answers; make it three-state (PASS / FAIL / INSUFFICIENT) so absence stays visible. Measured 2026-08-29: compliance-early-warning.ts summed balance-sheet concepts with '?? 0' and proceeded whenever ANY was present, so a filer tagging only one component produced a total of 0 and a clean pass on a ratio test. Absent data is not zero data. Staleness resolves the same way: a name whose newest usable quarter is 15 quarters old is unmeasured, not clean, and carrying its old ratio forward as current status is the same error wearing a different coat. Use evidenced() in scripts/lib/research-assertions.ts.
